# Disable side effects in rollup config

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

Currently we try to load wasm in `pvm-debugger-adapter` package but we don't need it. It looks `moduleSideEffects: false,` in rollup config works (there is no wasm in bundle anymore)

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Chores**
  - Improved build optimization to reduce unused code in the final output.
## Walkthrough

The Rollup configuration file was updated to add a `treeshake` option with `moduleSideEffects` set to `false`. This change directs Rollup to treat all modules as side-effect free, allowing for more aggressive removal of unused code during the build process. No other configuration aspects were altered.

## Changes

| File                                   | Change Summary                                                     |
|-----------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| tools/builder/rollup.config.js          | Added `treeshake: { moduleSideEffects: false }` to Rollup config.  |

`27-29`: **Good optimization for tree-shaking!**

This change to set `moduleSideEffects: false` is exactly what's needed to prevent WebAssembly modules from being unnecessarily included in the `pvm-debugger-adapter` package bundle. By telling Rollup that modules don't have side effects, it can more aggressively tree-shake and remove any unused imports.

This will result in a cleaner and potentially smaller bundle by excluding the wasm modules that aren't explicitly used in your code.
